cluster_summary_policy: only caller-declared non-trial sampling clusters; trial-level observations are aggregated without emitting one summary per trial

finite_record_bounds.unknown_completion: all Boolean values compatible with each observed field
finite_record_bounds.bounds_scope: four separate state-wise finite-record identification bounds; not a simultaneous region

fta_missing_outcome_bounds.work_budget: four owner tree evaluations bounded by maximum_tree_nodes and maximum_fault_tree_work
receipt_invariants: exactly four distinct Boolean truth-table rows
observed complete top-event count cannot exceed complete records
endpoint counts must reconcile with complete and incomplete record counts
endpoint probabilities must equal endpoint count divided by all supplied records
provider identity kind must match source digest availability
